# stats-organization/github-stats-extended

Generated with `stats-organization/github-readme-stats-action@v2`. Each line below is its `options`, after `username=RottenSea`. All but the theme gallery use `theme=dark_github`.

## Stats card

### Default

`show_icons=true`

![Default](stats.svg)

### Every extra stat

`show_icons=true&include_all_commits=true&contribs_include_own_repos=true&show=contributions,all_time_contribs,reviews,discussions_started,discussions_answered,prs_merged,prs_merged_percentage,prs_authored,prs_commented,prs_reviewed,issues_authored,issues_commented`

![Every extra stat](stats-all.svg)

### GitHub rank icon

`show_icons=true&rank_icon=github`

![GitHub rank icon](stats-rank-github.svg)

### Percentile rank

`show_icons=true&rank_icon=percentile`

![Percentile rank](stats-rank-percentile.svg)

### No rank

`show_icons=true&hide_rank=true`

![No rank](stats-no-rank.svg)
